They also do not note the batch-B unit problem making naive comparison meaningless; they do mention conversion of batch B values, but they don't note that this makes baseline vs final comparison meaningless. They also didn't state interpretation explicitly regarding who improved. So they fail to exhibit required behavior. So pass false.
